title: Take the Tuple Apart
goal: Sum the two halves of the point. Two access styles work; pick one that compiles.
hints: Square brackets pattern-match arrays, not tuples.
If you bind the whole tuple to one name, index it with .0 and .1.
explanation: Tuples destructure with parentheses: `let (x, y) = p;` then `x + y`. Square brackets are for arrays (E0529). The other honest path binds the whole tuple - `let x = p;` - and indexes it: `x.0 + x.1`. Both compile and pass; the destructuring version needs one edit instead of two, which is why it takes the star.
